messages:
maya: Quick follow-up to the retries RFC — proposal idea: enforce per-tenant + per-route retry buckets at the edge to prevent noisy tenants from starving others. Short thread to capture tradeoffs.
jorge: SG. Do you mean separate token/budget accounting for each tenant so hedging/retries consume a tenant-local budget?

maya: Exactly. Two axes: tenant isolation (so tenant A spike doesn't eat global retry budget) and route/priority buckets (so low-priority background routes don't exhaust fast-path retries).

sanjay: Concern: streaming requests. Retries for streaming aren't simple duplicates — you can leak KV cache, double-side-effects, and blow memory if we rehydrate. We should consider disabling automatic retries for non-idempotent streaming unless client supplies an idempotency key.

emma: We already pass x-request-id and have a backend idempotency header in some places. Proposal: require `x-idempotency-key` for cross-attempt replayability, otherwise retries limited to fast-fail hedging only (no resume).

jorge: Nice. Implementation detail: compute `retry_bucket = hash(tenant_id, route, priority)`; each bucket has tokens and refill rate. Failure types should weigh differently — 5xx consumes more, 429/503 maybe cheaper if transient. Also need eviction strategy for stale buckets.

maya: Here's a tiny config sketch (proto-like) for discussion:
```
ingress:
  retry_buckets:
    - name: tenant_route
      scope: tenant
      key: "tenant_id|route|priority"
      capacity: 50
      refill_per_minute: 30
      weights:
        5xx: 2
        429: 1
        timeout: 2
    - name: global_guard
      scope: global
      capacity: 200
      refill_per_minute: 100
```
Use-case: tenant-level bucket prevents noisy tenant from draining `global_guard` entirely.

ops-bot: FYI: last night's incident from tenant `analytics-42` showed retries spiking 3x and caused downstream timeouts — link: https://logs.internal/edge/3200123000 :eyes:

sanjay: Metrics we need: per-bucket token usage, per-tenant retry rate, succeeded-after-retry %, and retry-induced-duplicate-errors. Also want a gauge for streaming-retry-blocks to measure how often clients can't be retried.

emma: We should define behavior for cross-tenant fanout where a single logical request fans out to N tenants/services. What bucket charges? split across child buckets or parent? My vote: charge originating tenant + per-route child at lower weight.

jorge: Operationally, add an emergency toggle to disable tenant isolation quickly (for debugging) and a dry-run mode that logs when we'd have throttled. Also roll this behind a canary flag per region.

maya: Action items:
- @sanjay draft metric set + SLO changes (retry budgets)
- @jorge prototype bucket hashing + in-memory eviction strategy (bench memory)
- @emma map which routes are safe-for-retry vs streaming-only-no-retry
- I'll open a short RFC addendum and include the config sketch + ops plan

emma: +1. Can we also add a lint in the model onboarding checklist: mark models/routes as idempotent/streaming?

maya: Yes. Let's sync tomorrow 11am PT in infra sync. If no blockers, I'll spin up the RFC PR after that. :thumbsup:
